reason: A docked Web Shell plugin for DeepSeek Harness that exposes host-side bash or zsh sessions through a browser terminal, with resizable layout and profile-based state persistence.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可停靠的浏览器 Web Shell，通过 WebSocket 连接宿主 PTY，支持 bash、zsh 以及可调整和记忆的面板布局。
summaries.en: Provides a dockable browser-based Web Shell for DeepSeek Harness, connecting to host PTYs over WebSocket with bash and zsh support plus resizable, profile-persisted panel layout.

capabilities: Provides a docked browser-based shell terminal
Bridges a WebSocket connection to a host-side PTY
Runs bash or zsh processes with the dsh process operating-system permissions
Stores per-profile dock width and folded-state settings
